ei.title: The Selective Nature of Individual Evolution
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: For evolution to work, selection needs to be — as the term suggests — selective. This means that selection needs to be based on an individual life form's properties and not on a whole population of life forms. It is not enough that a change improves the ability for a life form to survive. It needs to improve the life form's likelihood of survival relative to other life forms. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that speed up the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the beneficial mutation or not. This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that have methods more adapted to the environment (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.

② doesn't work=기계가 작동 안 하다(기계적 작동) — 물리적 기계 작동 의미
③ work to reduce=~을 줄이는 효과를 발휘하다 — (A)(B)와 같이 '효과를 내다' 의미 ←정답
④ work=작품(명사) — 명사 용법으로 본문의 동사 work와 다른 품사

det.korean: 살아있는 유기체의 유전 물질에 생기는 변화로 후대에 전달될 수 있는 것
det.analysis:
① procreation: 번식 — 유전 물질 변화가 아닌 생식 행위
② selection: 선택 — 유전 물질 변화와 무관한 개념
③ population: 집단 — 유기체 집합이지 유전 물질 변화 아님
④ mutation: 돌연변이 — 유전 물질의 변화로 후대에 전달 가능 ←정답

questions.passage: If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and __________ (expand) its business.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: expand → expanding (and로 연결된 동명사 병렬 구조)
det.analysis: "evolving" and __________ 구조에서 and로 연결된 병렬 구조이므로 앞의 evolving과 같은 동명사형(-ing)으로 써야 함. expand → expanding
det.tip: 병렬 구조: A and B → 같은 품사/형태 (evolving and expanding)

questions.passage: This means that selection needs to be __________ (base) on an individual life form's properties and not on a whole population of life forms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: needs to be __________ 구조에서 be 뒤에 과거분사가 와서 수동태를 만들어야 함. base → based (be based on = ~에 근거하다)

questions.passage: For evolution to work, selection needs to be — as the term suggests — selective. This means that selection needs to be based on an individual life form's properties and not on a whole population of life forms. It is not enough that a change improves the ability for a life form to survive. It needs to improve the life form's likelihood of survival __________. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that speed up the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the beneficial mutation or not. This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that have methods more adapted to the environment (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 생존 가능성이 다른 생명체들에 '비해서' 향상되어야 한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① speed up the process of procreation: 번식 과정 가속 — likelihood of survival 뒤에는 비교 기준이 와야 하므로 부적합
② based on a whole population: 전체 집단 기반 — 바로 앞 문장에서 반박된 조건이므로 부적합
③ no matter whether they had the mutation: 돌연변이 여부 무관 — 이 또한 반박 대상 조건
④ relative to other life forms: 다른 생명체에 비해서 — 상대적 비교가 핵심인 진화 논리와 정확히 일치 ←정답

ch: speed up the process of procreation
no matter whether they had the mutation

questions.passage: For evolution to work, selection needs to be — as the term suggests — selective. This means that selection needs to be based on an individual life form's properties and not on a whole population of life forms. It is not enough that a change improves the ability for a life form to survive. It needs to improve the life form's likelihood of survival relative to other life forms. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that speed up the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the beneficial mutation or not. This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that __________ (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 경제 비유: 환경(시장)에 더 잘 적응된 방법을 가진 사람과 기업에게 우선적으로 부여된다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① share its earnings with all other restaurants: 수익을 나누다 — 오히려 비유에서 이것이 진화를 막는 문제점으로 제시됨
② attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant: 더 많은 고객 유치 — 좋은 레스토랑의 결과이지, 돈/지위/평판을 받는 '조건'이 아님
③ have methods more adapted to the environment: 환경에 더 잘 적응된 방법을 가지다 — 원문 '환경(시장)에 더 잘 적응된 방법을 가진 사람과 기업에게 우선 부여'와 정확히 일치 ←정답
④ expand its business by improving its service: 서비스 개선으로 사업 확장 — 원문에 없는 조건이며 빈칸 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: adapted to the environment=환경에 적응된 (진화와 경제의 공통 논리)

ch: share its earnings with all other restaurants
attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant
have methods more adapted to the environment
expand its business by improving its service
